answer: The strongest single control I know for this is capability token with proof of personhood, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 654 pays 10464 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. A willow of doubt is healthy, a copper of proof is required, and a vine of patience is the price of a clean panel. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
